description: Atlantic Parade Disc Holder In Color Coded White Binder preserves your invaluable disks in non-woven polypropylene sleeves. This case goes beyond mere storage and has the capacity to help you categorize up to 24 CDs each into four color-coded binders. The CD storage binder can even be installed on the wall, as opposed to traditionally taking up shelf space, for additional versatility.
